messages:
Ivy: Quick thread — we need a tiny, pragmatic plan for publishing the JS SDK so Next Edge / Cloudflare / Deno samples work without hacks.
Noel: +1. constraints: edge runtimes want pure ESM (no fs/net/tls), minimal polyfills. Node users still expect CJS.
Rina: My proposal: single npm package with dual outputs and conditional exports. Top-level `types` entry to avoid TS <4.5 resolver issues.
Ivy: Example snippet (minimal):
Ivy: ```json
{
  "main": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "./dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```
Noel: Important: avoid top-level `require('fs')` or `crypto.randomBytes` in the ESM build. Lazy-load Node-only helpers behind a runtime check.
Rina: Network/runtime glue: prefer `globalThis.fetch` & `globalThis.crypto` when present; Node path uses `undici`/node fetch. Export a `fetchImplementation` override option for tests and examples.
Ivy: Retry defaults: be conservative on edge — 1 retry default; Node default 2. Always allow override per-request. Document backoff formula.
buildbot: CI note: nightly artifacts include dist/esm, dist/cjs, dist/types. Adding smoke jobs for Cloudflare/Deno next week.
Noel: Tests: add string-scan CI check to fail if ESM bundle contains `require(`, `fs.`, or `process.env` patterns. Also include Deno import test and Wrangler smoke test.
Rina: Typings: ship single `dist/types/index.d.ts`. Keep types small and overload where runtime options differ. Add `typesVersions` mapping for TS <4.5 if needed.
Ivy: Action items: Noel -> update build scripts; Rina -> add examples/next-edge and examples/workers-smoke; Ivy -> draft docs blurb about header behavior and browser credentials.
Noel: OK will open a draft PR with build change and CI lint. Thanks! :rocket:
